histogram_reconstruction: Decode orbit-ordered labels. Pair counts sum1 into (labels[i],labels[j],labels[(i+j)%r]); unary b counts sum1 into (labels[i],labels[(2*i+b)%r]). Scalar-labelled orbit is charged instrumentation, not a decoder.
null_generator: SplitMix64; rejection-bounded Fisher-Yates; fresh original labels each repetition; matched shuffle permutes nonzero sign-pair labels and fixes identity. Analytically derived control arrays consume no RNG/permutation/pair visits.
derived_control_justification: Constant and bijective projections have zero pair/unary entropy after any codomain/domain relabeling. Kummer matched sign-pair shuffles are codomain permutations and preserve both pair and unary entropies; profile checked before reuse. All remaining null values are measured census values.
cost_scope: Exact entropy integer counters plus log-table storage; source/input certification and projection/sort/codec CPU also included in whole-process time. Orbit is shared across six projections, not six independently charged setups.
sampling_error: none for full finite populations; null ensemble variation is retained, no inferential test
